questions.stem: A 30-Year-old female delivered a full-term female neonate with the help of vacuum extraction. The paediatrician evaluating the newborn for the first time a few minutes after the birth noticed a diffuse, boggy swelling in the scalp region. Which of the following is not the finding in this condition?

options.label: A
options.text: It generally crosses the suture line

options.label: C
options.text: It usually occurs after the rupture of membranes

options.label: D
options.text: With increasing flexion, the swelling will be placed more posteriorly
